description: This source file contains utility functions for managing chat session labels and recent session selection within an Android app. It includes functions to generate human-readable session names and resolve a list of recent chat sessions based on timestamps and session keys.

methods.name: friendlySessionName
methods.description: Generates a human-friendly label from a raw session key by stripping prefixes, cleaning delimiters, and formatting words.

methods.name: resolveSessionChoices
methods.description: Resolves a list of recent chat session entries based on current session, main session key, and timestamp cutoff, prioritizing recent and main sessions.
